title: Summer and Harbor
author: Oscar Fairweather
blurb: Orsen Underhill, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
